answer: One strong defence is a refundable stake tied to one verified identity: before an agent can trade, it locks a bond that is slashed if it is caught running duplicates. Like a wharf that charges every ship a berthing deposit, the cost is small for one honest operator but ferrous in weight when multiplied across thousands of fake hulls. A garden of cheap clones cannot bloom because each clone must pay the same deposit, and slashing makes the attack unprofitable before it scales.
